nodes.label: The species queue (1,442 cells by value provenance)
nodes.rationale: Bounded at 35 species, one search each, and deliberately run one batch per session so the rest of the work continues. The search key is taken from the book's own References because the bibliography maps species to compilation and URL construction is refused by the fetch tool.

nodes.label: NIST ASD's three markings and their distance from measurement
nodes.rationale: plain = optimised from measured lines (one inversion); [ ] = interpolation, extrapolation or a Ritz-type series fit (two); ( ) = ab initio (none from measurement). Pattern so far: no ASD level is a direct measurement.

nodes.label: Triples, not cells — (1-f)^3 survival and the LOPT ceiling
nodes.rationale: The bracket relates T(n-1), T(n), T(n+1), so a cell is an independent test only if all three levels are independent: one derived level poisons three tests. And because LOPT fits neighbouring levels from overlapping line sets, even the triple count is a ceiling. asd_pass.py counts triples.

nodes.label: He I entirely bracketed — §22.9's defence unsound
nodes.rationale: 189 cells, every level bracketed and no observed values at all: n<=10 from Drake's theory anchored to Kandula's measured ground level, n>=11 by fitting the extended Ritz quantum-defect expansion. The provenance note settled it before a delimiter was counted.
